name: Villa Mallorca
signature: Paused listing: a Mount Martha guesthouse previously described as two apartment retreats. Current operation and booking availability are unverified.
editorNote:
This listing is paused while we confirm whether Villa Mallorca is accepting guests. Its recorded operator domain did not resolve in a direct check on 1 October 2026, and no current first-party booking page was found. Third-party inventory and older guest reviews do not establish present availability. Do not plan a stay around this listing until the host confirms that bookings have resumed.

Earlier third-party descriptions presented a Mediterranean-style Mount Martha property with two apartment retreats, a garden and a shared pool. Older reviews name Paul and Sheree as hosts and describe meals and music. These are historical reports, not verified current hosts, services or booking inclusions.
whyWeGo: The Mount Martha stay was previously described in traveller reviews, but this listing is paused until an official source confirms current operation.
ifOnlyOneThing: Confirm current availability directly with the host before planning a stay.

No operator page and no closure notice were found, so trading status is unresolved and no replacement URL is recorded.
